integrity: Finite verification is corroborative, not a proof of the infinite parameter theorem; no independent review or certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only sigma=q and d>=2; relies on Kuttner--Wang projective irreducibility/order correspondence. Generalized prescribed constants and unequal Frobenius bases are not classified; previously implicit norm-fiber derivations remain an originality risk.
title: Exact constant-coefficient fibers of irreducible projective polynomials
